leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a linear scan algorithm to identify peak elements in an array
Construct a binary search approach for efficient peak detection
Initialize and manipulate pointer variables to track array indices during traversal
Apply conditional logic to compare adjacent elements and identify peaks
Configure edge case handling for arrays with single elements or boundary peaks
Integrate validation checks to ensure input array integrity
Render test cases with various array configurations to verify algorithm correctness
